release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (datasheet-axis-f4005-e-dome-sensor-unit-en-US-270067.pdf). Sensor unit only: power, storage, codecs, protocols and RTSP come from the paired AXIS F-series main unit, so no configs are recorded.
